title: Midsummer Night
offer: Midsummer night at my hall! We need two crates of mead, and garlands of flowers from Solby for the maypole. Come yourselves, in your new dresses!

steps.say: Mead for the feast! Now the garlands.

steps.load_say: We wove them all morning. They smell of summer!

steps.say: The garlands are up, the torches are lit, and everybody dances around the pole! Uncle Sven sings too loud. What a night!

fact: Midsummer, the longest day, was a great feast in the north, with fires and dances.
